systems.summary: Alert and oriented x3. Pain score 4/10. Morphine PCA initiated.
Extubated, on face mask O2 6L/min. Chest physio started. Bilateral chest drains — serosanguinous fluid.
concerns: Monitor chest drain output for haemothorax

systems.summary: NSR on telemetry. Weaning noradrenaline. Chest drains: R=50 mL, L=60 mL since op.
UO 0.8 mL/kg/hr. IDC in situ. Cr baseline 98 — mild AKI watch.
NBM. Sips of water tolerated. NGT removed. Bowel sounds present.
Sternal wound dry, intact. Leg harvest site clean, no ooze.

plan.task: Wean noradrenaline — target OFF if MAP stable
Remove chest drains if drainage <100 mL/24hr
Continue insulin infusion, 2-hourly BSL monitoring
K+ replacement per sliding scale (target >4.0)
Chest X-ray
Cardiology review
Mobilise with physio if haemodynamically stable

family.notes: Wife present overnight, aware of surgery outcome, very supportive. Family updated.

mainConcerns: Watch chest drain output for haemothorax
triggers: Sudden increase in chest drain output

systems.summary: Sedated — Propofol 20 mL/hr + Fentanyl 25 mcg/hr. RASS -2. Daily wake-up trial planned at 0600.
Mechanically ventilated. Thick yellow-green secretions, q2h suction. CXR: RLL consolidation. Prone considered if P/F <150.
Tachycardic. On dual vasopressors. Echo yesterday: LVEF 50%, no effusion. Septic source = lungs.
UO 20 mL/hr (declining). AKI Stage 2. Cr trending up. Nephrology aware — may need CRRT.
NGT in situ. EN at 20 mL/hr (target 60 mL/hr). Omeprazole 40 mg IV OD.
No pressure injuries. Flowtron boots on. Turn q2h protocol.
Septic shock — RLL pneumonia. Day 2 Meropenem. Sputum C&S pending.

plan.task: Daily wake-up trial — assess extubation readiness
Repeat lactate — if >3.5 consider CRRT discussion
Chase sputum C&S results — ID review today
Repeat echo if haemodynamics worsen
Target fluid balance: EVEN to -500 mL
Family meeting — prognosis discussion

family.notes: Husband at bedside. Parents informed by phone. ICU limitations explained. Family meeting 1400 — poor prognosis discussion.

systems.summary: GCS pre-sedation E2V1M4 (7). ICP 18 mmHg — acceptable but trending up. CPP 84. Pupils R 3mm sluggish, L 3mm reactive.
Mechanically ventilated. Clear secretions. Lungs clear bilaterally. SaO2 99%.
Sinus bradycardia — baseline. Noradrenaline to maintain CPP. ECG: no arrhythmia.
UO 1.2 mL/kg/hr. IDC in situ. Cr normal.
concerns: Monitor for diabetes insipidus — 2-hourly UO charting

systems.summary: NGT in situ. EN at 40 mL/hr (target 60). HOB at 30°. Omeprazole IV.
Post-craniotomy wound (R frontal/temporal) — dressing intact, no ooze. ICP bolt site clean.

plan.task: Maintain ICP <20 mmHg, CPP >70 mmHg
Neurosurgery review — repeat CT if ICP spikes
Daily sedation holiday — neuro assessment
Target Na 145-150 (3% NaCl infusion)
Continue seizure prophylaxis x 7 days
Physiotherapy — passive limb movement
Family update by neurosurgery team

family.notes: Wife and parents at waiting area. Tamil interpreter arranged. Very anxious — needs regular updates.

systems.summary: Deeply sedated (RASS -4) + paralysed during prone. Last neuro exam: follows commands at RASS 0. Wake-up hold when supine.
Severe ARDS. Currently prone — improving PaO2. Frothy white secretions, q2h closed-circuit suction. Last ABG: pH 7.36, PaCO2 52, PaO2 68.
Sinus tachycardia improving. No vasopressors. Echo Day 3: RVSP 38, mild RV strain.
CKD baseline — Cr 168 (up from 130). UO 45 mL/hr with furosemide. Avoiding nephrotoxins.
EN via NGT 50 mL/hr continuous. Hold feed during supination turns. Target 1500 kcal/day.
Full prone check q4h. Facial oedema noted — eye pads in place. No pressure injuries. Mouth care q4h.

plan.task: Supinate — 2-nurse check, note ETT depth before/after
Stop cisatracurium once supine and stable
ABG 1 hour post-supination — if P/F <150 re-discuss proning
Last dose Oseltamivir tonight
Furosemide BD — target -1L fluid balance/day
Repeat echo if RV strain worsens

family.notes: Family very distressed. Spiritual care requested. DNR discussion planned — not yet decided.

mainConcerns: Severe ARDS with suboptimal P/F despite proning

systems.summary: Alert, GCS 15. Abdominal pain 4/10. Very anxious — first ICU admission, new T1DM diagnosis.
Self-ventilating on room air. Kussmaul breathing improving. SpO2 98% RA.
Mildly tachycardic, improving. BP 108/65 with fluid resuscitation. ECG: T-wave flattening (hypokalaemia).
Oliguric AKI Stage 3. CRRT commenced 0200. Fluid removal 100 mL/hr. UO pre-CRRT <5 mL/hr.
NBM (nausea/vomiting). Antiemetics prescribed. NGT on free drainage. Gastric aspirate 200 mL.

plan.task: Continue CRRT — target pH >7.35, Cr trending down
Hourly BSL — titrate insulin to BSL 10-14
K+ replacement protocol — recheck in 2 hours
Endocrine review — new T1DM insulin planning
Nephrology handover for CRRT management
Psychology/social work consult when stable

family.notes: Single, lives alone. Parents travelling from Penang — ETA 8 hours. Contacted by phone. Very anxious. Patient has asked about parents repeatedly.

mainConcerns: Risk of hypokalaemia during insulin infusion
First T1DM admission — needs education and psychological support
triggers: CRRT circuit fails and cannot be re-established

codeStatus.details: Full Code (Advance Directive: no CPR if primary graft non-function)

allergies.reaction: Contact reaction — strict latex-free environment required

systems.summary: Alert and oriented, GCS 15. Brief confusion episode at 0200 — resolved. DDx: ICU delirium vs Tacrolimus neurotoxicity.
SV on 2L NPO2, SpO2 96%. R pleural effusion on CXR — monitoring. Incentive spirometry TDS.
Stable, no vasopressors. Hepatic artery doppler q6h — last reading triphasic flow, RI 0.68 (normal). No HAT.
concerns: Hepatic artery thrombosis risk — q6h doppler

systems.summary: UO 0.9 mL/kg/hr. Tacrolimus nephrotoxicity risk. Cr 112 (baseline 110).
T-tube draining green bile 120 mL (appropriate). JP drains: RUQ combined 60 mL serosanguinous. EN via NGT 50 mL/hr. Trial oral diet today.
CMV prophylaxis ongoing. BAL Galactomannan pending. Strict latex-free environment. Blood cultures pending (fever spike Day 1).

plan.task: Tacrolimus dose increase — pharmacist to advise (trough 6.2, target 8-12)
Hepatic artery doppler — alert surgeon if RI <0.5 or loss of triphasic
LFTs, INR, renal panel
T-tube: measure and record output every shift
Trial oral diet — dietitian review
Transplant hepatology ward round
Chase blood culture and Galactomannan results — ID review if positive

family.notes: Family understand gravity of post-transplant period. Dato' Rashid specifically requested to be called for any clinical deterioration.

mainConcerns: Tacrolimus sub-therapeutic — risk of acute rejection
triggers: Hepatic artery doppler abnormal (RI <0.5 or loss of triphasic flow)
Sudden increase in JP drain output (?haemorrhage)
